title: English: Our Community 🏘️
summary:
1. Places in Our Community:
Our town has many places! A Cinema (to watch movies), Restaurant or Cafe (to eat), Sports centre (to play sports), Mall (a big shopping centre), Park (to play outside), Fire station (for fire engines), Hospital (for sick people), Supermarket (to buy food), Toy shop, Shoe shop, and a Library (to read books).

2. Prepositions of Place (Where is it?):
• In: Inside something.
• On: On top of something.
• Behind: At the back.
• In front of: Facing something.
• Beside: Next to something.
• Between: In the middle of two things.

3. There is / There are:
• Use There is for ONE thing (There is a park).
• Use There are for MORE THAN ONE thing (There are two cafes).

4. Giving Directions:
To help people find a place, we can say: Turn left, Turn right, or Go straight on.

questions.questionText: To find the hospital, do not turn left. You must turn ______!

questions.questionText: To go to the mall, just go ______ on.
